releases.name: Tivano 1.2.7
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v1.2.7/Tivano-1.2.7.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

If Tivano 1.0.2 or earlier reports HTTP 403 while checking updates, install this DMG manually once. Later checks use public static feeds and do not require a GitHub login.

## Bug fixes

- Stop hidden chat columns from repeatedly attempting blank-viewport repairs; resume layout checks when the conversation is shown again.
- Cancel obsolete viewport refreshes and pause elapsed-time updates in hidden chats.

## Refinements

- Update row-height estimates incrementally to reduce repeated history scans during streaming replies.

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
